_comment: Built-in presets. 'args' are yt-dlp options written like on a command line; 'description' is the hint shown under the dropdown. Presets you save from the app go to presets.json in your settings folder instead.

presets.name: Best video – MP4 (plays everywhere)
presets.description: Best quality that plays on any phone, TV or computer.

presets.name: 1080p MP4
presets.description: Full HD video, H.264 + AAC. Very compatible.

presets.name: 720p MP4 (smaller file)
presets.description: HD video at roughly half the size of 1080p.

presets.name: Max quality – MKV (4K/VP9/AV1)
presets.description: Highest resolution available (4K and above). Best played on a computer, e.g. with VLC.

presets.name: Audio – MP3 (best quality)
presets.description: Sound only, as an MP3 that plays everywhere.

presets.name: Audio – original (no re-encode)
presets.description: Sound only, in the site's original format (often Opus or M4A). No quality loss.
